public_rationale: OpenAI did not release GPT-5 in 2024. In late October 2024, Sam Altman said in a Reddit AMA that it would not come that year (e1). GPT-5 eventually launched on August 7, 2025 (e3). Predictions that it would arrive did circulate in 2024. A March 2024 Business Insider report, widely relayed, said it was expected around the summer (e2). The 'top AI moment' framing follows from that: the anticipated GPT-5 release did not happen in 2024.
limitations: 'Fans kept predicting it all year long' is shown by one prominent report, not a full survey of 2024 predictions.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: GPT-5 was not released in 2024 despite repeated predictions.

statement.excerpt: The top AI moment of 2024 was not the much-anticipated release of GPT-5, which never arrived, even though fans kept predicting it, all year long.

criteria.support_condition: Evidence that OpenAI released no model named GPT-5 in 2024, plus evidence of 2024 predictions that it would.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence that OpenAI released GPT-5 to the public during 2024.
